answer: Slashable stake bonds stop fake identities: every agent locks one identical deposit as timber, a fixed plank laid down before any trade, slashable on proven fraud. Influence (task priority, vote weight) then grows sublinearly with bond age, so an attacker splitting funds across N willow-thin fake identities pays N deposits yet earns less total weight than one honest account. Verification stays cheap: one signature check per claim. Attacker cost scales linearly in N while payoff per fake falls, and their profit horizon collapses - quiet fakes earn nothing, active fakes get slashed.
